posts.title: Of Course Emacs has an MPD client
posts.description: I recently started getting back into listening to my offline music library as a way to improve focus – my long-forgotten Linux ricing neurons immediately whispered "install you must, MPD" 1 . MPD is a fairly lightweight music player daemon, with plenty of frontends designed for it over the years. ncmpcpp and rmpc are fairly good examples of such frontends.
